captions.start: On hands and knees, back flat
captions.go: Stretch one arm and the other leg out
captions.top: Level with your back: hold 2 seconds

steps.text: Kneel on a mat on your hands and knees: hands under your shoulders, knees under your hips.
Stretch one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Stop when they are level with your back and hold for two seconds.
Bring them back slowly, then do the other arm and leg.

safety: Keep your back flat and do not twist.
Use a mat or a folded towel under your knees.

mistakes.label: arm_leg_low
mistakes.wrong: your arm and leg did not reach the level of your back
mistakes.right: Stretch your arm and leg a little further, towards the level of your back, only as far as feels steady.

mistakes.label: back_sag
mistakes.wrong: your lower back dipped or your hips tilted while you stretched
mistakes.right: Keep your back flat and your hips level.
